CustomObject.description: The TurboSign Event is a child of TurboSign Envelope and forms the append-only signature trail shown on the record. It records Event Type, Occurred On, the Recipient Email, the Source (webhook, poll, or local), and a raw payload fragment for debugging. Dedupe Key (required, unique external ID) makes webhook retries and overlapping polls idempotent. Commonly used for the event timeline and reporting.
CustomObject.label: TurboSign Event
